rule: **C++**: namespace-qualified with dots: `ns.Class#method`, `ns.func`; `Class::static()` → `Class#static`; template arguments dropped. Free function: its name (with the language's module qualifier where it has one). Generic/template type arguments are dropped from every ID (`HashSet#<init>`). Overloads share one ID.
notes: Namespace-qualified with dots: nested namespaces give util.detail.mix. The two log overloads share the ID util.log (both as callers and callees). A bare clamp(b) inside util::detail resolves lexically to util::clamp, the same ID as the qualified util::clamp(a) (C1). detail::mix and util::detail::mix are one ID. Functions in the global namespace (global_helper, main) are bare; ::global_helper is the same function. call_type: free functions are 'direct'; calls naming a member of a type (including static members called as Class::m() and implicit-this bare member calls) are 'method'; SPEC does not define the split further.
